title_en: A doubled middle letter: Form II
q_en: Why is there a shadda in the middle of this verb, and what does it change?
q_ar: لِمَاذَا الشَّدَّةُ فِي وَسَطِ هَذَا الْفِعْلِ؟ وَمَاذَا تُغَيِّرُ؟
not_yet: Form I and Form II are the only shapes of this lesson: the others (with an alif, or with تَـ in front) come later.
Verbs whose doubled letter is part of the root itself (like the ones with a double final letter): Lesson 48.
The noun that names the action (such as the word for teaching): Lesson 53.
not_yet_ar: نَتَعَلَّمُ هُنَا الْوَزْنَ الثَّانِيَ فَقَطْ: وَالْأَوْزَانُ الْأُخْرَى (بِأَلِفٍ أَوْ بِتَاءٍ فِي الْأَوَّلِ) تَأْتِي بَعْدُ.
الْأَفْعَالُ الَّتِي يَكُونُ التَّضْعِيفُ فِيهَا مِنْ أَصْلِ الْجَذْرِ: فِي الدَّرْسِ ٤٨.
الِاسْمُ الَّذِي يُسَمِّي الْفِعْلَ (كَالتَّعْلِيمِ): فِي الدَّرْسِ ٥٣.

lines: Which letter of each verb has a shadda? Is it the first, the middle or the last?
أَيُّ حَرْفٍ فِيهِ شَدَّةٌ فِي كُلِّ فِعْلٍ؟ الْأَوَّلُ أَمِ الْأَوْسَطُ أَمِ الْأَخِيرُ؟
In عَلَّمَ الْحَبِيبُ أَحْمَدَ الصَّلَاةَ, who knows the prayer at the end? Who made it so?
فِي «عَلَّمَ الْحَبِيبُ أَحْمَدَ الصَّلَاةَ»: مَنْ يَعْرِفُ الصَّلَاةَ فِي النِّهَايَةِ؟ وَمَنْ جَعَلَهُ يَعْرِفُهَا؟
In the present tense, what comes before the first root letter? Is it يَـ or يُـ?
فِي الْمُضَارِعِ: مَاذَا يَأْتِي قَبْلَ أَوَّلِ حُرُوفِ الْجَذْرِ؟ يَـ أَمْ يُـ؟

cards.def_en: The middle root letter is written twice. Present: يُـ at the start.
He knew → he taught (made another know).
Drop يُـ; the last letter takes sukūn.

slides.note: The doubled letter is the sign of Form II in all three.

slides.head_en: Quiz: Form I or Form II? What does it mean?

slides.why: A student writes عَلِمَ الْمُعَلِّمُ الْوَلَدَ الدَّرْسَ for “The teacher taught the boy the lesson”. Wrong! عَلِمَ means “he knew”. To make the boy know, the middle letter doubles: عَلَّمَ الْمُعَلِّمُ الْوَلَدَ الدَّرْسَ.
slides.why_ar: كَتَبَ طَالِبٌ «عَلِمَ الْمُعَلِّمُ الْوَلَدَ الدَّرْسَ». هَذَا خَطَأٌ! «عَلِمَ» مَعْنَاهُ: عَرَفَ. وَلِيَجْعَلَ الْوَلَدَ يَعْلَمُ نُضَعِّفُ الْحَرْفَ الْأَوْسَطَ: عَلَّمَ الْمُعَلِّمُ الْوَلَدَ الدَّرْسَ.

sections.name: A
sections.en: Read the story, then answer.
lines: فِي الْمَسَاءِ جَلَسَ أَحْمَدُ فِي حَلْقَةِ الْحَبِيبِ.
In the evening Ahmad sat in the Habib’s circle.
سَلَّمَ أَحْمَدُ عَلَى الْحَبِيبِ، وَسَلَّمَ الْحَبِيبُ عَلَيْهِ.
Ahmad greeted the Habib, and the Habib greeted him.
Then the Habib reminded the students of good manners.
وَعَلَّمَ أَحْمَدَ صَلَاةً عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ.
And he taught Ahmad a ṣalāt on the Prophet ﷺ.
قَالَ الْحَبِيبُ: قُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمْ.
The Habib said: Say: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon him.
فَقَالَهَا أَحْمَدُ، وَكَبَّرَ الطُّلَّابُ وَسَبَّحُوا اللَّهَ.
Ahmad said it, and the students said “Allāhu akbar” and glorified Allah.
ثُمَّ دَرَّسَ الْحَبِيبُ الدَّرْسَ، وَفَهَّمَ الطُّلَّابَ الْكَلِمَاتِ الْجَدِيدَةَ.
Then the Habib taught the lesson and made the students understand the new words.
وَقَدَّمَتْ مَرْيَمُ الطَّعَامَ لِلضُّيُوفِ، وَنَظَّفَ عُمَرُ الْمَسْجِدَ.
And Maryam served the food to the guests, and ʿUmar cleaned the mosque.
فَذَكَّرَ أَحْمَدُ عُمَرَ بِالصَّلَاةِ، لِأَنَّ الْوَقْتَ قَرِيبٌ.
So Ahmad reminded ʿUmar of the prayer, because the time was near.

sections.name: P
sections.en: Find the mistake.

items.en: A student writes this for “The teacher taught the boy the lesson.” What is wrong?
items.model: عَلِمَ means “he knew”. To teach, the middle letter doubles: عَلَّمَ.

items.en: A student writes this for “The Habib teaches the students.” What is wrong with the ending?
items.model: الطُّلَّابُ must be الطُّلَّابَ: they are the ones taught, not the doers.

items.en: A student translates: “The imam grew big.” What is wrong?
items.model: With the doubled letter the verb means “he said Allāhu akbar”, not “he grew big”.

items.en: A student writes this for “Maryam served the food to the guests.” What is wrong?
items.model: The doer is Maryam, a girl: the verb must be feminine: قَدَّمَتْ مَرْيَمُ.

sections.name: Z
sections.en: The Story Strip: lines 1–74
lines: A boy went to a mosque.
The boy sat in the mosque.
The boy opened a muṣḥaf (a copy of the Qur’an).
The boy read in the muṣḥaf.
The boy sat in the study circle.
The friends went to the mosque.
The students read in the books.
The Habib sat in the mosque.
The Habib is a righteous man.
Is the Habib in the mosque?
Yes, the Habib is in the mosque.
The boy came in through the door.
The mother looked at the boy.
The boy sits in the study circle today.
Maryam is reading the muṣḥaf now.
The boy was happy in the majlis.
Maryam was happy in the study circle.
The boy did not leave the majlis.
لَنْ يَجْلِسَ الْوَلَدُ فِي الْبَيْتِ غَدًا.
The boy will not sit at home tomorrow.
ذَهَبَ الْوَلَدُ مَعَ الْأَبِ إِلَى الزِّيَارَةِ.
The boy went with the father to the ziyāra (the visit).
The boy sat with good manners in the majlis.
The boy heard the Rātib (the litany) with his father.
ذَهَبَ الْوَلَدُ فِي الصَّبَاحِ إِلَى بَيْتِ الْحَبِيبِ.
The boy went in the morning to the Habib’s house.
The boy sat in the circle of dhikr (remembrance of Allah).
The Habib asked him about the lesson.
The boy served the guests and carried the food.
ثُمَّ جَلَسَ الْوَلَدُ مَعَ الْحَبِيبِ وَسَمِعَ الدَّرْسَ.
Then the boy sat with the Habib and heard the lesson.
The guests thanked the boy who served them.
حَفِظَ الْوَلَدُ مَا سَمِعَ مِنَ الْحَبِيبِ.
The boy memorised what he heard from the Habib.
فَهِمَ الْوَلَدُ الدَّرْسَ لِأَنَّهُ خَدَمَ الضُّيُوفَ.
The boy understood the lesson because he served the guests.
فِي الْمَجْلِسِ خَمْسَةُ ضُيُوفٍ وَسَمِعَ الْوَلَدُ كُلَّ كَلِمَةٍ.
There are five guests in the majlis, and the boy heard every word.
جَاءَ الْوَلَدُ إِلَى الرِّبَاطِ فِي الصَّبَاحِ.
The boy came to the ribāṭ in the morning.
The Habib said: Knowledge is light.
سَأَلَ عُمَرُ صَدِيقَهُ: هَلْ أَنْتَ ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى الرَّوْحَةِ؟
Umar asked his friend: Are you going to the rawḥa?
سَمِعَ الْوَلَدُ مِنَ الْحَبِيبِ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: الصَّلَاةُ نُورٌ.
The boy heard from the Habib: The Prophet ﷺ said: Prayer is light.
The boy opened his muṣḥaf and read his wird (his daily portion).
صَلَّى الْوَلَدُ مَعَ الطُّلَّابِ ثُمَّ دَعَا.
The boy prayed with the students, then made duʿāʾ.
قَرَأَ الْوَلَدُ الْمَوْلِدَ لِأَنَّ مَحَبَّةَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فِي قَلْبِهِ.
The boy read the mawlid because love of the Prophet ﷺ is in his heart.
قَالَ الْحَبِيبُ لِأَبِي الْوَلَدِ: وَلَدُكَ طَالِبُ عِلْمٍ.
The Habib said to the boy’s father: Your son is a student of knowledge (ṭālib ʿilm).
جَلَسَ الْوَلَدُ فِي مَجَالِسِ الْعُلَمَاءِ فِي تَرِيمَ.
The boy sat in the gatherings of the scholars in Tarim.
يُقَالُ إِنَّ الْإِمَامَ وُلِدَ فِي تَرِيمَ.
It is said that the Imam was born in Tarim.
It was said to the boy: Knowledge is light.
عَلَّمَ الْحَبِيبُ الْوَلَدَ: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ.
The Habib taught the boy: O Allah, bless and grant peace to our master Muḥammad ﷺ.
The boy reminded his friend of the prayer.
